en: Swap two neighbouring items to line up 3 or more of the same kind.
Reach the goal at the top before your moves run out: collect items, find paw-print clues, or pop bubble wrap.
4 in a row = Siren · L or T = Bubble Bomb · 5 in a row = Gold Badge. Swap two specials together for a mega combo!
Win for 1 star, score high for 2 or 3. Every win unlocks a new level, forever.
Collect the items shown at the top
Find every paw-print clue: match on top of them
Pop all the bubble wrap (match the wrapped items)
Collect the items AND find the paw prints
Spare moves turn into bonus points!
Swap two specials for a mega combo!
